title: Add an EasyScript function
summary: Add a helpful built-in function to EasyScript, like 'wrap(value, low, high)' or 'chance(percent)'.
why: Small helpers make scripts shorter and easier to read for beginners.
learn: How a programming language's built-in functions work

steps.text: Pick a function that beginners would find useful and that isn't there yet (check the Scripting Reference).
Add it in engine/src/aven/script/stdlib.cpp with vm.defineFunction, with a friendly error message when used wrongly.
Build and run the tests: cmake --build build && build/bin/aven_tests
Regenerate the function list in the docs: tools/docs/make_api_reference.sh

submit: Open a pull request. Put 'Quest: add-a-script-function' in the description.
